verbs.name: weather
verbs.description: Set the sky over the whole world until it is set again: fair, overcast, rain, storm or snow. rain and snow also take an intensity of light or heavy; the other three words ignore it.

verbs.name: standing
verbs.description: Say where the player now stands with one person in this world: stranger, acquainted, friendly, close friend or hostile. The optional line is what that person remembers them by.
